metadata.question: Did smoke plumes from the Itcha Lake fire spread south into the US Pacific Northwest on September 2, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to look for smoke/aerosol data on September 2, 2025 - Location: Itcha Lake fire area (British Columbia, Canada) and check for southward spread into US Pacific Northwest - Best datasets: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI for aerosol index, or MODIS/VIIRS for aerosol optical depth - FIRMS for active fire detection might help locate the fire 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed - we're looking FOR smoke/aerosols - Need to check aerosol index or AOD values - High aerosol index indicates smoke presence 3. Logic: - First locate Itcha Lake fire area (approximately 52.5°N, 125°W in BC) - Check aerosol patterns on Sept 2, 2025 - Determine if high aerosol values extend south from fire location into US Pacific Northwest (Washington/Oregon area, below 49°N) - Valid detection of aerosols = A (Yes), No significant aerosol spread = B (No) - No data/invalid = C1/C2/C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const fireLocation = ee.Geometry.Point([-125.0, 52.5]); // Itcha Lake, BC const usPNW = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-125, 49], [-125, 42], [-116, 42], [-116, 49], [-125, 49]] ]); // US Pacific Northwest (south of Canadian border) const date = '2025-09-02'; const dateStart = '2025-09-01'; const dateEnd = '2025-09-03'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-5P Aerosol Index let aerosolCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_AER_AI') .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd) .filterBounds(fireLocation.buffer(500000)); // 500km buffer around fire console.log('Aerosol images found:', aerosolCol.size().getInfo()); if (aerosolCol.size().getInfo() === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-5P data available. Trying MODIS Terra AOD...'); aerosolCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD08_D3') .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd) .select('Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Mean'); console.log('MODIS images found:', aerosolCol.size().getInfo()); if (aerosolCol.size().getInfo() === 0) { console.log('No aerosol data available for the date.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Processing - Get aerosol values const aerosolImg = aerosolCol.mean(); const bandName = aerosolCol.first().bandNames().getInfo()[0]; // Check aerosol levels near fire source const fireAerosol = aerosolImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: fireLocation.buffer(50000), scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(bandName); const fireAerosolVal = fireAerosol.getInfo(); // Check aerosol levels in US PNW const pnwAerosol = aerosolImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: usPNW, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(bandName); const pnwAerosolVal = pnwAerosol.getInfo(); // Count valid pixels in US PNW const pnwPixelCount = aerosolImg.select(bandName).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: usPNW, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(bandName); const pnwPixels = pnwPixelCount.getInfo(); console.log(`Fire area aerosol (${bandName}):`, fireAerosolVal); console.log(`US PNW aerosol (${bandName}):`, pnwAerosolVal); console.log('Valid pixels in US PNW:', pnwPixels); // 4. Validation & Answer if (pnwPixels === 0) { console.log('No valid aerosol data over US Pacific Northwest.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (pnwAerosolVal === null || fireAerosolVal === null) { console.log('Calculation returned null values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Determine if smoke spread south // For Sentinel-5P AER_AI: values > 1 indicate elevated aerosols/smoke // For MODIS AOD: values > 0.3 indicate elevated aerosols const threshold = bandName.includes('AER_AI') ? 1.0 : 0.3; if (pnwAerosolVal > threshold && fireAerosolVal > threshold) { console.log(`Elevated aerosols detected in both fire area and US PNW (threshold: ${threshold}).`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`No significant smoke spread to US PNW detected (PNW: ${pnwAerosolVal.toFixed(3)}, threshold: ${threshold}).`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
